def process(loadBeach2002, loadBeach2003, loadBeach2004, loadBeach2005, loadBeach2006, loadBeach2007, loadBeach2008, loadBeach2009, loadBeach2010, loadBeach2011, loadBeach2012, loadBeach2013, loadBeach2014, loadBeach2015, loadBeach2016, loadBeach2017, loadBeach2018, loadBeach2019, loadBeach2020, loadBeach2021, loadBeach2022, loadBeach2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    dfs = [
        loadBeach2002, loadBeach2003, loadBeach2004, loadBeach2005, loadBeach2006,
        loadBeach2007, loadBeach2008, loadBeach2009, loadBeach2010, loadBeach2011,
        loadBeach2012, loadBeach2013, loadBeach2014, loadBeach2015, loadBeach2016,
        loadBeach2017, loadBeach2018, loadBeach2019, loadBeach2020, loadBeach2021,
        loadBeach2022, loadBeach2023,
    ]
    all_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Keep marine beaches only
    marine = all_df[all_df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'marine'].copy()

    # Standardize violation to boolean
    v = marine['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    marine['isExceed'] = v.isin(['yes', 'y', 'true', '1'])

    marine['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(marine['Year'], errors='coerce')

    annual = (
        marine.groupby('Year', as_index=False)
        .agg(totalSamples=('isExceed', 'size'), exceedSamples=('isExceed', 'sum'))
    )
    annual['avgExceedanceRate'] = annual['exceedSamples'] / annual['totalSamples']
    annual = annual.sort_values('Year')
    annual['prevYear'] = annual['Year'].shift(1)
    annual['prevRate'] = annual['avgExceedanceRate'].shift(1)
    annual['rateDiff'] = annual['avgExceedanceRate'] - annual['prevRate']

    # For the question: year with the highest average exceedance rate difference vs previous year.
    yoy = annual.dropna(subset=['rateDiff']).copy()
    max_row = yoy.loc[yoy['rateDiff'].idxmax()]

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'metric': 'marineAvgExceedanceRateDiff',
        'year': int(max_row['Year']),
        'value': float(max_row['rateDiff']),
    }])

def process(rainBoston, rainChatham) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    def prep(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        out = df.copy()
        # keep rows where Year is numeric
        out['YearNum'] = pd.to_numeric(out['Year'], errors='coerce')
        out = out[out['YearNum'].notna()].copy()

        # Parse monthly values; treat 'M', 'T', blanks as missing
        month_cols = ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']
        for c in month_cols:
            out[c] = (
                out[c]
                .astype(str)
                .str.strip()
                .replace({'M': np.nan, 'm': np.nan, 'T': np.nan, 't': np.nan, '': np.nan, 'nan': np.nan, 'None': np.nan})
            )
            out[c] = pd.to_numeric(out[c], errors='coerce')

        # Impute missing with median of that month across non-missing years
        for c in month_cols:
            med = out[c].median(skipna=True)
            out[c] = out[c].fillna(med)

        out['jjaTotal'] = out[month_cols].sum(axis=1)
        return out[['YearNum', 'jjaTotal']].rename(columns={'YearNum': 'Year'})

    b = prep(rainBoston).rename(columns={'jjaTotal': 'bostonJja'})
    c = prep(rainChatham).rename(columns={'jjaTotal': 'chathamJja'})

    merged = b.merge(c, on='Year', how='inner').sort_values('Year')
    merged['totalJjaRain'] = merged['bostonJja'] + merged['chathamJja']
    merged['prevTotalJjaRain'] = merged['totalJjaRain'].shift(1)
    merged['rainDiff'] = merged['totalJjaRain'] - merged['prevTotalJjaRain']

    yoy = merged.dropna(subset=['rainDiff']).copy()
    max_row = yoy.loc[yoy['rainDiff'].idxmax()]

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'metric': 'totalJjaRainDiff',
        'year': int(max_row['Year']),
        'value': float(max_row['rainDiff']),
    }])
